## GameApplication component
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Constant Binding Injects.GameApp

### Description
Represents the core of the Game, typically where all visible components would be created and/or added to the stage such as Backgrounds, Symbols and the Cabinet.

Has no implementation within the package so is required to be implemented by the game project.

Should implement the interface `IGameApp`.

### API

#### initPixi(options: PIXI.ApplicationOptions): void;
Should initialise PIXI by creating a new PIXI.Application with the passed options.

Internally called by the engine:
- after all injections
- after bootstrap completes
- after Vues mounted
- before Cabinet initialisation

#### init(): void;
Should initialise all the components of the game, excluding the Cabinet which auto initialises itself before this is called.

Internally called by the engine straight after Cabinet initialisation.

#### resize(width: number, height: number): void;
Should resize all the visible components in the game.

Internally called by the engine once after init() then again on every `GLOBAL.ORIENTATION_CHANGE` event.

### BareBones Example
```ts
// file game-application.ts

export class GameApplication implements IGameApp {
    private pixiApp: PIXI.Application;

    public initPixi(options: PIXI.ApplicationOptions): void {
        this.pixiApp = new PIXI.Application(options);
    }

    public init(): void {
    }

    public resize(width: number, height: number): void {
        this.pixiApp.renderer.resize(width, height);
    }
}
```
